title: Data Cleaning Challenge reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong solution for Data Cleaning Challenge should meet the objective: Clean inconsistent and missing values in a toy dataset; state every transformation and explain how it will be applied without leakage. It should preserve a repeatable test setup, document its assumptions, and distinguish measured results from hypotheses.
explanation: Review the reasoning, not only the required words: inspect whether the test design matches the objective, the result is reproducible, and limitations are reported honestly.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
